result.summary: Several visual and data issues found: invalid delivery fee showing as NaN, truncated restaurant names and category chips, and partial clipping of UI elements on the right edge.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows “€NaN delivery”, which is invalid/broken data instead of a real delivery fee.
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery-fee formatting logic to handle missing/null values (e.g. show “—”, “Free”, or a fallback price) and never render NaN to users.

issues.description: Restaurant name “Trattoria Piccol” is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line names, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with full name on a detail view so labels are fully readable.

issues.description: Category filter chips (e.g. Healthy) and the third restaurant card are clipped on the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll areas have proper padding/inset and that the last visible items are not cut off mid-content.

issues.description: Delivery time badges and card images in “Fastest near you” have uneven cropping and alignment compared to neighboring cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize card image aspect ratios, badge positioning, and spacing for a consistent grid.
